ideas.title: Ilhan Omar's Involvement in COVID-19 Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate allegations against Rep. Ilhan Omar and her potential involvement in a $250M COVID-19 meal fraud scheme.
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail and examine Omar's connections to the scheme
questions: What is Ilhan Omar's role in the scheme?
How much did she benefit from the scheme?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal a significant abuse of power and corruption within the government.

ideas.title: Minnesota's Culture of Tolerance towards Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the 'culture of tolerance' towards fraud in Minnesota and its impact on taxpayers.
ideas.angle: Analyze the root causes of this culture and potential solutions
questions: What are the root causes of this culture?
ideas.insight: This story could lead to significant reforms within the state's systems.
